title: Easy Tomato Rice — A Recipe
text: This recipe is for four people. You need a lot of rice — two cups — and a little oil. You also need three tomatoes, one onion, some salt and a few vegetables. You don't need much sugar; you don't need any at all. First, cut the onion and the tomatoes. Second, put a little oil in the pan and cook the onion for two minutes. Then add the tomatoes and some salt. Add the rice and enough water to cover it. Cook it for twenty minutes. Don't add too much water! Finally, put the vegetables on top and eat it hot.
